description: Give a member, group or API key access to a filesystem, or change the mode of its grant. Sets the same grant when repeated, so it is safe to retry. Needs a management key (mtblm_) or the login of an owner or admin; an API key gets management_key_required. org_id is optional: a key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.

principal_id.description: the member's, group's or API key's ID

name: set_grant
